title: Maximum Subarray Sum After Multiplier
summary: Given an integer array nums and a positive integer k, you must select exactly one subarray and perform either of the following operations: - Multiply each element in the chosen subarray by k.
statement: Given an integer array nums and a positive integer k, you must select exactly one subarray and perform either of the following operations: - Multiply each element in the chosen subarray by k. - Divide each element in the chosen subarray by k, using the floor value for positive numbers and the ceiling value for negative numbers. After performing the operation, calculate the maximum possible sum of any non-empty subarray in the resulting array. The subarray chosen for the operation and the subarray chosen for the sum may be different.
constraints: nums is nonempty and k is positive.
Choose one contiguous segment and either multiply all of it by k or divide all of it by k with truncation toward zero.
After that operation, return the maximum sum of any nonempty contiguous subarray.
reference_solution:
def maximum_subarray_after_multiplier(nums,k):
    negative=float('-inf');before=0;multiplied=divided=after=negative;answer=negative
    for value in nums:
        old_before,old_multiplied,old_divided=before,multiplied,divided
        before=max(old_before,0)+value
        multiplied=max(old_before,old_multiplied,0)+value*k
        divided=max(old_before,old_divided,0)+int(value/k)
        after=max(old_multiplied,old_divided,after)+value
        answer=max(answer,before,multiplied,divided,after)
    return answer
